definition: Average of published final-fortnight statewide/national voting-intention polls minus the actual One Nation first-preference share, percentage points. Positive = polls overstated One Nation.

qld2017.note: One Nation contested 61 of 93 seats; statewide intention questions still asked of every respondent.

qld2024.note: One Nation contested all 93 seats. Only two final-fortnight polls separately report One Nation in the retrieved table.

sa2026.note: The closest analogue: One Nation surging above 20% at a state election. One Nation won 4 seats and ran second in 29.

not_usable.wa2017: Final WA 2017 polls did not report One Nation separately (it sat inside Others); actual 4.93%.

use: Model v1.12 sets One Nation's shared election-wide poll error from these cases: mean correction -bias_mean_shrink x mean error, sd max(RMS, bias_sd_floor_on). The floor (2.0 pp) is kept above the 1.0 pp RMS because four elections in other jurisdictions are thin evidence for a party polling 22%.
